utterance: Make the human notice the egg
stimulus: The speckled egg moves in the edge of the frame
perception: Eyes turn toward its motion before the head
decision: Decide whether it is in danger
anticipation: Blink stops and the neck leads into a lean
action: Eyes lock on egg; head follows; torso rotates slightly
consequence: Body changes travel direction toward nest
camera: Hold medium framing with both egg and eyes visible
audio: Small rustle then egg roll; no dramatic score yet
failed_pattern: Head rotates before the egg moves
repair_strategy: Start eye direction only after observable egg movement

utterance: Make him hear something behind him
stimulus: An offscreen thump reaches him
perception: Ear/head attention shifts toward sonic source
anticipation: Foot freezes and shoulder lifts
action: Eyes move left; head rotates; torso follows later
consequence: Now faces the unseen source
camera: Begin on his profile, retain screen geography of sound
audio: Offscreen low thump can correctly lead reveal
failed_pattern: Character reacts before thump without an intended premonition
repair_strategy: Key perception after sound onset; let head follow ears

utterance: Have the character search the forest
stimulus: Ambience suddenly becomes quieter
perception: Notices gaps in known animal sounds
anticipation: Pause gait and adjust balance
action: Eye scan left-right; head catches up; step to clear obstruction
consequence: Threat location becomes a plausible next reveal
camera: Do not cut away during essential glance changes
audio: Fade bird ambience then focused leaf rustle
failed_pattern: Random head wiggle with no visual target
repair_strategy: Assign three look targets tied to sound and scene geometry

utterance: She realizes the egg belongs to her
stimulus: Mother finds nest empty then sees egg in human arms
perception: Her gaze alternates between nest and egg
anticipation: Body stiffens; nostrils widen
action: Head lowers and body points toward egg
consequence: Aggression becomes understandable
camera: Over-shoulder or shared axis includes nest, egg, mother
audio: One low breath rising toward roar
failed_pattern: Instant anger before seeing empty nest or egg
repair_strategy: Stage empty nest and egg eyeline before posture change

utterance: He sees the branch before ducking
stimulus: Low branch approaches on chase path
perception: Eyes track branch and available clearance
anticipation: Quick head tuck and knee flex
action: Torso folds; hips lower; feet maintain forward contact sequence
consequence: Passes safely beneath branch
camera: Keep branch edge and head in same shot
audio: Wind rush ahead of nearest foliage brush
failed_pattern: Character ducks before any branch is visible
repair_strategy: Show obstacle well before avoidance beat

utterance: He hesitates before deciding to rescue
stimulus: Egg balances near ledge edge
perception: Looks from egg to safe exit route
anticipation: Weight rocks backward then forward
action: Hand retracts briefly then reaches firmly
consequence: Commitment has clear visible turning point
camera: Hold stable composition during decision
audio: Ambient detail drops; tiny egg scraping gains prominence
failed_pattern: Linear reach with no hesitation despite scripted indecision
repair_strategy: Insert separate opposing anticipation and commitment poses

utterance: Make the first step look grounded
stimulus: Human has fully emerged from portal
decision: Choose where to plant leading foot
anticipation: Hips shift over current support
action: Leading foot swings then plants; hips transfer onto it
consequence: Trailing foot is released and body advances
camera: Full figure and ground horizon in frame
audio: Soft heel/sole contact on plant frame
failed_pattern: Root slides at uniform speed while foot planted
repair_strategy: Lock planted foot in world coordinates and solve knee

utterance: Make the character walk naturally
stimulus: Character sees desired destination
anticipation: Body leans by small angle
action: Alternate stance and swing with independent support foot
consequence: Head and arms overlap the stride
camera: Side-on readable feet and floor
audio: Footfalls at support transitions; footsteps vary slightly
failed_pattern: Sinusoidal legs with no support lock
repair_strategy: Use stride phase and world-space support anchors

utterance: Make the escape urgent
stimulus: Dinosaur finishes roar and leans toward human
anticipation: Sharp pivot, compress and push off
action: Root accelerates; feet alternate airborne and grounded phases
consequence: Distance from threat briefly grows
camera: Track both subjects long enough to read pursuit
audio: Breath, faster footfalls, mother footsteps on separate stem
failed_pattern: Root begins at full speed with still-facing character
repair_strategy: Anticipation pose then accelerating trajectory and foot phase

utterance: Make him turn before running
stimulus: He notices danger behind him
anticipation: Hips load supporting foot
action: Eyes/head/shoulders/hips turn in sequence, feet pivot
consequence: Exit direction becomes unambiguous
camera: Keep screen direction constant and hold turn in shot
audio: Shoe friction sound on pivot contact
failed_pattern: Translate left while torso still faces right
repair_strategy: Use staggered yaw/key poses followed by push off

utterance: Make the dinosaur stop convincingly
stimulus: Baby chirp reaches mother mid-run
anticipation: Lower body, shorten stride, forelegs react
action: Hips decelerate; planted foot skids briefly; tail keeps moving
consequence: Dinosaur stops with visible mass and tail settle
camera: Wider view retains feet and moving tail
audio: Two heavy decelerating footfalls, tail whoosh then quiet
failed_pattern: Instant zero velocity with frozen tail
repair_strategy: Apply finite braking distance and delayed tail follow-through

utterance: Make him nearly fall but recover
stimulus: One shoe catches exposed root
perception: Sees falling ground and egg at risk
decision: Keep egg safe and restore balance
anticipation: Arms clamp egg; torso pitches
action: Recovery step lands ahead of tipping center of mass
consequence: Body regains balance without dropping egg
camera: Hold continuous medium-wide to show foot and hands
audio: Scuff, gasp, heavy recovery step
failed_pattern: Sudden spin or squash with no visible trip cause
repair_strategy: Root contact first; move COM toward failure then plant recovery foot

utterance: Make the egg pickup readable
stimulus: Human notices egg resting on ground
anticipation: Bend knees, open hands, align approach
action: Hands reach egg and close after contact
consequence: Egg becomes attached to two-hand prop anchor
camera: Close enough to see contact, wide enough for posture
audio: Cloth movement then light finger/shell contact
failed_pattern: Egg jumps to hands before touch
repair_strategy: Switch parent or hand constraint only at contact event

utterance: Make him catch the falling egg
stimulus: Egg leaves nest under gravity
anticipation: Knees load and arms extend
action: Hands intercept moving egg, absorb momentum, retract
consequence: Egg remains stable after capture
camera: Hold egg trajectory and hands in same frame
audio: Egg scrape, brief whoosh, contact muffled by hands
failed_pattern: Egg disappears from air and reappears held
repair_strategy: Intersect continuous paths and attach at shared contact frame

utterance: Keep egg attached during chase
stimulus: Human has just caught egg
anticipation: Bring elbows close to ribs
action: Arms counteract gait; egg stays in torso-relative cup
consequence: Egg never clips torso or floats outside hands
camera: Use frame including chest, hands, and escape path
audio: Subtle shell/rubbing noise, no separate random thumps
failed_pattern: Egg independently interpolates with its own X movement
repair_strategy: Drive egg from established hand attachment transform

utterance: Make him gently put the baby down
stimulus: Mother waits and baby wriggles
anticipation: Crouch and align baby over ground
action: Lower baby until feet contact; open hands after support
consequence: Hands withdraw; baby stands independently
camera: Avoid cut at release; feet must remain visible
audio: Soft toe contact precedes cloth release sound
failed_pattern: Baby teleports from hands to ground
repair_strategy: Release ownership only after ground contact constraint is valid

utterance: Pass an object from one character to another
stimulus: Receiver reaches toward offered object
perception: Both characters follow object with gaze
anticipation: Receiver opens hand; giver slows
action: Receiver grips at overlap then giver releases
consequence: Object remains continuously supported
camera: Two-shot with hands sharing spatial region
audio: Fabric and soft grip sounds at hand overlap
failed_pattern: Object briefly floats between characters
repair_strategy: Dual-grip interval then explicit ownership change

utterance: Make a door open when pushed
stimulus: Closed door blocks character route
perception: Eyes settle on handle and hinge
anticipation: Feet brace and shoulder leans
action: Hand contacts door; shoulder and arm push, door rotates at hinge
consequence: Character steps through clear opening
camera: Three-quarter shot demonstrates hinge axis
audio: Latch click then hinge creak and footstep
failed_pattern: Door swings before hand reaches it
repair_strategy: Hinge angle driven only after visible hand force begins

utterance: Make the dinosaur foot feel heavy
stimulus: Mother lifts a foot over ground
anticipation: Knee bends and body mass lowers
action: Foot contacts ground and ground elements compress
consequence: Torso and tail settle; leaves react a few frames later
camera: Low angle framing reveals full contact and scale
audio: Low-frequency impact plus leaf/rattle transients
failed_pattern: Camera shakes before footfall without intentional J-cut
repair_strategy: Tie peak impulse to contact frame and weight transfer

utterance: Make the firing action physically legible
stimulus: Character voluntarily performs a stylized fictional firing action
perception: Eyes align with prop and target
anticipation: Body braces; shoulder and arms stabilize
action: Prop emits flash then arms, shoulders and torso recoil
consequence: Balance adjusts and muzzle settles
camera: Show source and recoil without obscuring action
audio: Sharp fictional sound follows source event, then tail decay
failed_pattern: Flash-only with static shooter
repair_strategy: Trigger flash and whole-body recoil keyed from common event time

utterance: Make the hit clearly understandable
stimulus: Moving object visibly reaches target
anticipation: Body has braced or remains unaware as intended
action: Contact compression; torso moves, limbs and head lag
consequence: Body recoils or falls with follow-through
camera: Show target contact clearly before close emphasis
audio: Contact transient then clothes/grunt and lingering room tone
failed_pattern: Random wiggle and flash without actual collision
repair_strategy: Drive recoil by contact time, force direction and coordinated poses

utterance: Make the jump landing have weight
stimulus: Character falls toward chosen landing spot
anticipation: Knees begin extending toward floor
action: Feet touch then knees/hips compress
consequence: Torso settles; arms counterbalance and recover
camera: Wide view with feet and landing plane
audio: Foot impact at measured contact frame, small fabric tail
failed_pattern: Instantly frozen pose at ground y
repair_strategy: Vertical path intersects floor then compressed body pose

utterance: Make him push a heavy boulder
stimulus: Boulder blocks travel
anticipation: Feet spread; torso leans; hands press
action: Shoulders drive force and boulder begins moving after resistance
consequence: Character follows moving mass slowly
camera: Wide framing includes feet, contact and boulder
audio: Stone scraping begins after applied force
failed_pattern: Boulder glides away before character touches it
repair_strategy: Constraint requires hand contact and push threshold

utterance: Make the dinosaur break the branch
stimulus: Branch lies across mother's pursuit path
decision: Continue chase through the obstacle without stopping
anticipation: Neck ducks imperfectly; shoulders drive forward
action: Head/shoulder impacts branch; bending precedes snapping
consequence: Pieces move outward with gravity and drag
camera: Preserve recognizable branch and dinosaur contact point
audio: Wood strain then sharp crack at fracture, leaves after
failed_pattern: Branch explodes before dinosaur reaches it
repair_strategy: Fracture only on predicted geometry contact and threshold

utterance: Make the man genuinely emerge from a portal
stimulus: Portal opens anchored at ground
perception: Human looks out from inside the aperture
anticipation: Hand grips near rim, leading foot tests ground
action: Head/torso/legs cross plane with masks and weight transfer
consequence: Trailing foot exits; entire body outside and stable
camera: Camera maintains aperture, threshold and planted foot
audio: Portal hum swells as near/far sound perspective changes
failed_pattern: Character slides in from offscreen in front of portal
repair_strategy: Use portal interior mask + exterior character layers and crossing states

utterance: Make ducking under a branch credible
stimulus: Branch appears in path ahead
decision: Choose to lower center of mass
anticipation: Head tucks and knees flex
action: Torso, hips and head move under obstacle while feet continue
consequence: Character rises only once head clears
camera: Hold enough profile for top of head and branch
audio: Near-ear branch swish only at closest pass
failed_pattern: Torso drops after head already intersects branch
repair_strategy: Lower before collision and track clearance frame-by-frame

utterance: Make the mother squeeze through a narrow opening
stimulus: Portal aperture is narrower than her snout
anticipation: Neck draws back slightly
action: Snout contacts rim; rim stretches; head advances
consequence: Portal recoil trails departure of contact
camera: Oblique framing shows rim shape around snout
audio: Elastic hum and rim strain synchronized to deformation
failed_pattern: Dinosaur materializes inside room with no threshold crossing
repair_strategy: Drive rim deformation from signed penetration/contact

utterance: Make the crash through foliage readable
stimulus: Dense fern screens the chase route
perception: Dinosaur sees travel corridor through leaves
decision: Keep advancing into the obstructing foliage
anticipation: Head pushes foliage ahead of torso
action: Leaves bend before tearing, then separate and fall
consequence: Branch and leaves retain momentum after passage
camera: Do not hide every contact with particles
audio: Layered leaf rustle, tearing, delayed falling leaves
failed_pattern: Decorative green particles appear before foliage touched
repair_strategy: Simulate progressive contact response then fragment release

utterance: Make arrival in apartment geographically coherent
stimulus: Portal connects prehistoric forest to apartment
perception: Human sees a floor immediately beyond rim
anticipation: Leading foot tests carpet
action: Body crosses plane; contact surface/material changes
consequence: Footstep texture changes and apartment reverb appears
camera: Match screen direction through plane or clearly re-establish
audio: Cross-portal ambience and carpet foot sound with perspective
failed_pattern: New room starts with character already fully in it
repair_strategy: Match portal world transform and mask over cut

utterance: Make a gap jump visually plausible
stimulus: Character sees missing ground ahead
anticipation: Knees compress and arms swing back
action: Takeoff occurs at edge, airborne arc crosses gap
consequence: Landing contacts far side and absorbs momentum
camera: Wide shot shows both edges and full trajectory
audio: Takeoff scrape, airborne quiet, landing thump
failed_pattern: Character teleports over gap with linear root X and constant Y
repair_strategy: Define takeoff/contact frames and continuous ballistic-like arc

utterance: Make the character hesitate before acting
stimulus: An uncertain obstacle threatens success
perception: Looks at obstacle then possible exit
anticipation: Small backward weight shift and incomplete reach
action: First movement aborts, brief hold, second committed gesture
consequence: Decision becomes visible through contrast
camera: Keep medium composition stable to read micro-actions
audio: Small breath and pause; avoid excessive stinger
failed_pattern: Uniform slow movement called hesitation
repair_strategy: Distinct blocked attempt, pause and committed pose

utterance: Show fear without cartoon jitter
stimulus: A huge dinosaur lowers head toward human
perception: Human notices threatening gaze and jaw
anticipation: Breath catch; neck retracts; shoulders rise
action: Recoil and protective posture, then pivot
consequence: Fear visibly changes goal and locomotion
camera: Maintain threat and human in eyeline sequence
audio: Low breath, reduced ambience, sharp inhale
failed_pattern: Whole-body random wiggle before threat becomes known
repair_strategy: Trigger reaction from recognition then coordinated protective posing

utterance: Make him curious about the new world
stimulus: Human emerges into unfamiliar forest
anticipation: Lean forward while keeping planted foot
action: Eyes rise, head tilts, hand reaches toward leaf
consequence: Discovering motivates next movement
camera: Hold revealing foreground plant in shared frame
audio: Gentle leaves and quiet interested breath
failed_pattern: Random tilt without visible subject
repair_strategy: Anchor every glance and reach to a plant or sound

utterance: Make the relief after the chase feel earned
stimulus: Mother nuzzles newborn instead of threatening
anticipation: Chest holds breath then softens
action: Shoulders lower, grip relaxes, knees unlock
consequence: Human smiles and regains normal posture
camera: Move to less compressed medium framing only after recognition
audio: Music opens after safe nuzzle; exhale prominent
failed_pattern: Instant smile at first appearance of baby despite danger
repair_strategy: Make mother-behavior verification precede relaxation

utterance: Make mother and baby contact tender
stimulus: Baby reaches mother's lowered muzzle
perception: Both make eye contact and orient toward each other
anticipation: Mother slows head approach; baby leans up
action: Gentle nose-to-head contact; subtle compression
consequence: Mother raises head slightly; baby follows with gaze
camera: Sustain readable two-shot and silence
audio: Quiet chirp, warm breath, restrained chord after contact
failed_pattern: Faces touch only because both sprites overlap with no anticipation
repair_strategy: Establish attention, approach speed, contact deformation and recovery

utterance: Make a funny delayed reaction
stimulus: Unexpected giant snout begins stretching portal
perception: Human perceives odd shadow and hears creak
anticipation: Character stays still for one beat, eyes shift
action: Head turns slowly, then body springs in exaggerated shock
consequence: Pause after reveal lets joke land
camera: Keep snout offscreen long enough to earn reveal
audio: Creak then intentionally awkward silence and short accent
failed_pattern: Random instant scream before audience sees the snout
repair_strategy: Set up sightline, delayed recognition, decisive reaction and hold

utterance: Make the chase easy to follow
stimulus: Human runs left and dinosaur follows from right
anticipation: Start tracking after running speed is established
action: Camera moves to retain positions while foreground parallax passes
consequence: Dinosaur closing distance is measurable
camera: Side tracking, ground horizon and direction locked
audio: Independent footfalls and whoosh anchored to camera perspective
failed_pattern: Camera crosses axis and swaps predator/prey sides accidentally
repair_strategy: Define chase axis and camera path preserving screen direction

utterance: Reveal the dinosaur's size dramatically
stimulus: Ground begins vibrating before creature appears
perception: Audience hears offscreen footsteps and sees human reaction
anticipation: Hold lower portion of frame with shadow and foot
action: Tilt or reframe from foot to massive head
consequence: Character scale is established in shared geography
camera: Begin low, let human remain a size reference
audio: Low footfalls can intentionally precede visual reveal
failed_pattern: Immediate face close-up removes size information
repair_strategy: Reveal scale by connected view foot→body→head

utterance: Give the cracking egg cinematic importance
stimulus: Egg produces first quiet crack amid noisy chase
perception: Human hears a small unexpected sound
decision: Direct viewer to source without losing geography
anticipation: Brief hold and human glance
action: Camera gently pushes to shell crack after hand/egg visibility
consequence: Crack becomes new center of attention
camera: Push-in motivated by recognition, return to wider shot
audio: Duck music so shell transient is audible
failed_pattern: Random dramatic zoom unrelated to what characters see
repair_strategy: Begin after eye contact establishes source, preserve orientation

utterance: Cut between views without teleporting
stimulus: Human begins lifting baby in wide shot
decision: Show hand contact close, then return wide
anticipation: Hand approaches, cut on continuous movement
action: New shot continues same hand/egg positions and phase
consequence: Object geography remains consistent over cut
camera: Match hand vector/axis, not just any position
audio: Maintain one continuous Foley trajectory across cut
failed_pattern: Hands reset to old position after cut
repair_strategy: Record world state at edit and reconstruct new camera pose

utterance: Use sound to lead the next revelation
stimulus: Mother footfall happens outside camera frame
perception: Human hears source while camera stays with him
anticipation: Hold reaction shot longer before cut
action: Offscreen effect begins as spatial cue; camera reveal follows
consequence: Sound is justified when mother becomes visible
camera: Hold first shot, reveal source in next
audio: J-cut is intentional; label offscreen origin in cue sheet
failed_pattern: All audio early labelled error or disconnected thump
repair_strategy: Define emitter position and audible event before picture reveal

utterance: Make the baby reveal emotionally powerful
stimulus: First hatch chirp cuts through chase chaos
anticipation: Music and effects reduce before baby appears
action: Hold baby emergence with minimal score then gentle return
consequence: Emotional reversal becomes audible and visible
camera: Stable two-shot then close detail only if needed
audio: Short audible void/duck, intimate chirp, softer ambience
failed_pattern: Constant loud music masks the tiny hatch
repair_strategy: Sidechain/automation of score around baby chirp event
